title: Add a feature across three files
prompt: Add a `slugify(text)` function to src/strings.js: lower-case, ASCII letters and digits only, words joined by single hyphens, no leading or trailing hyphen ("  Hello, World!  " becomes "hello-world"). Export it from src/index.js alongside the others. Then add a `--slug` option to cli.js that prints the slug of the remaining arguments joined by spaces, e.g. `node cli.js --slug Barrel Jumper 2` prints `barrel-jumper-2`.
